shift.heading: Why does your team need AEO, not more SEO?
shift.body: Most programs still teach SEO habits: keyword lists, backlink audits, ranking reports. None of it tells a client whether ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google's AI actually mention their brand, and your trainers are the ones fielding that question first. AEO is a different discipline: win share of voice in the answer, not just a click.
proofStrip: 42% of B2B searches now resolve inside an AI answer (Tinuiti, Q1 2026)
3.2× more citations after an AEO content rewrite (our engagements)
Close to zero blue links most users click before acting on an AI answer

items.question: What is the AEO masterclass program?
items.answer: It's a modular, five-workshop Answer Engine Optimization program that takes a team from understanding AEO to a 90-day action plan. The five workshops run across three phases, Understand, Decide, Act, and can be booked together as a curriculum or individually.

items.question: Can I book a single masterclass instead of all five?
items.answer: Yes. Every workshop stands alone and builds its own artifact, a prompt library, weighting matrix, metrics dashboard, or 90-day sprint plan. You can run one, or all five in sequence.

items.question: Who is the masterclass program for?
items.answer: It's built for internal L&D teams and agencies running an ongoing AEO coaching program across multiple client cohorts, rather than a one-time audience. For a single event, a keynote or panel is the better fit.

items.question: How much does the AEO program cost?
items.answer: The full two-day, on-site program starts at $7,500 (excluding travel). Final scope and price depend on cohort size and how many of the five workshops are booked together.

items.question: Does Bjorn speak at events?
items.answer: Yes, keynotes, panels and podcast appearances on AI search and Answer Engine Optimization, tailored to the audience. Share your event details through the form to check availability.
